description: This Java source file defines a custom exception, PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException, used in the context of policy request handling within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides constructors, builder pattern support, and metadata related to throttling excessive policy modifications.

classes.name: PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when too many modifying requests are made to a policy in a short period, indicating request throttling.

classes.name: PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException with a fluent API.
